name: com.janorium/mcp
title: Janorium
description: Backtest crypto trading strategies on Binance spot and futures history with Janorium (free).

environmentVariables.name: CB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Janorium API key (cbk_…): janorium.com → Settings → API keys. Scopes read + run; optimize, research, publish only if needed.

environmentVariables.name: CB_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Janorium REST API base URL. Leave unset for the public platform.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REQUIRE_CAMPAIGN
environmentVariables.description: true: refuse every run outside a campaign with a locked holdout (guards a strategy search against overfitting). false: one-off runs need no campaign.
